title: Threavia
description: Follow and answer your Threavia coding agents from the editor.

title: CodePilot-ai-assistant
description: AI coding assistant for VS Code: chat with your files, inline edit with diff preview, and searchable chat history. Works with any OpenAI-compatible API.

title: TabFold: Tab Groups
description: Group, name, color and collapse editor tabs like Chrome — on the tab bar and in the sidebar. No network, no telemetry, no runtime dependencies.

title: Routinel – API Finder & Client
description: Routinel (Route + Sentinel) auto-discovers every HTTP API in your workspace — any language, with parameters — and calls them from a built-in Postman-like client.

title: Jobwatch: GPU Jobs and Spend
description: Your Hugging Face Jobs in the VS Code status bar: what is running, what it has cost so far, and an alert when a job fails, runs out of memory, nears its timeout or sits in the queue.

title: Universal Diff Viewer
description: Review image, text, spreadsheet and document changes in a VS Code tab.
